topic: Sold out of the seven herbs

guest.name: 石井さん
guest.role: owner of {八百勝|やおかつ}, the greengrocer on the shopping street; brisk, friendly shopkeeper talk, very polite on paper

title_jp: {七草|ななくさ}セットのお{詫び|わび}
context: Thursday 7 January, the day for {七草|ななくさ}がゆ. {恵子|けいこ}さん sends アルちゃん to the greengrocer for the herbs, but a polite notice is taped to the box instead.
scene: 7 January. {恵子|けいこ}さん needs the seven herbs for the rice porridge. At the greengrocer, the box is empty, with a very polite notice on it.

phrases.jp: ご{迷惑|めいわく|trouble, inconvenience|3}をおかけして、{申し訳ありません|もうしわけありません|I'm very sorry|3}。
phrases.en: I'm very sorry for the trouble.
phrases.note: The standard work apology. Even more formal: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません.

phrases.jp: {今年|ことし}は{野菜|やさい}が{高い|たかい}らしいよ。
phrases.en: Apparently vegetables are expensive this year.

phrases.jp: {少々|しょうしょう|a little (polite)|3}お{待ち|まち}いただけますか。
phrases.en: Could you wait a moment, please?
phrases.note: Shop and phone keigo. {少々|しょうしょう} = polite ちょっと.

phrases.jp: {七草|ななくさ|the seven spring herbs|3}がゆを{食べる|たべる}と、{一年|いちねん}{元気|げんき}に{過ごせる|すごせる}らしい。
phrases.en: They say if you eat seven-herb porridge, you'll stay healthy all year.

phrases.jp: {税込|ぜいこみ|tax included|3}でおいくらですか。
phrases.en: How much is it with tax?
phrases.note: Opposite: {税抜|ぜいぬ}き (before tax). Price tags often show both.

dialogue_setting: A handwritten notice taped to an empty cardboard box outside {八百勝|やおかつ}, the greengrocer on the shopping street, on a frosty morning.
text_title: {八百勝|やおかつ}よりお{知らせ|しらせ}

dialogue.speaker: Title
dialogue.jp: {七草|ななくさ|the seven spring herbs|3}セット{品切れ|しなぎれ|out of stock|3}のお{詫び|わび|apology|2}
dialogue.en: Apology: seven-herb sets out of stock

dialogue.speaker: Notice
dialogue.jp: {本日|ほんじつ}の{七草|ななくさ|the seven spring herbs|3}セットは、{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{品切れ|しなぎれ|out of stock|3}となりました。
dialogue.en: Today's seven-herb sets sold out in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Apology
dialogue.jp: ご{迷惑|めいわく|trouble, inconvenience|3}をおかけして、{誠に|まことに|truly, sincerely (formal)|2}{申し訳ございません|もうしわけございません|I'm terribly sorry|3}。
dialogue.en: We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience.

dialogue.speaker: Reason
dialogue.jp: {市場|しじょう|(wholesale) market|3}の{話|はなし}では、{年末|ねんまつ}の{寒波|かんぱ|cold wave|2}のせいで、{今年|ことし}は{数|かず|number, quantity|3}が{少ない|すくない}らしいです。
dialogue.en: According to the market, the cold wave at the end of the year means there are apparently fewer this year.

dialogue.speaker: Restock
dialogue.jp: {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}に、{少しだけ|すこしだけ}{追加|ついか|addition, extra|3}で{入荷|にゅうか|new stock arriving|2}いたします。
dialogue.en: A few more will come in at 3 p.m.

dialogue.speaker: Price
dialogue.jp: {仕入れ値|しいれね|wholesale cost|2}が{上がった|あがった}ため、1パック398{円|えん}（{税込|ぜいこみ|tax included|3}）とさせていただきます。
dialogue.en: As our costs have gone up, the price will be 398 yen a pack (tax included).

dialogue.speaker: Thanks
dialogue.jp: いつもご{来店|らいてん|coming to the shop|2}いただき、ありがとうございます。{八百勝|やおかつ} {石井|いしい}
dialogue.en: Thank you, as always, for shopping with us. {八百勝|やおかつ}, {石井|いしい}

listening.intro: {石井|いしい}さん spots you reading the notice and leans out of the shop.

lines.jp: 3{時|じ}にまた{来て|きて}よ。ひとつ{取っておく|とっておく|to set aside, keep|3}から。
lines.en: Come back at three. I'll put one aside for you.

grammar.meaning: apparently, it seems (from what I hear)
grammar.form: verb / い-adj: plain form + らしい ({過|す}ごせる → {過|す}ごせるらしい, {少|すく}ない → {少|すく}ないらしい) · な-adj / noun: no だ ({静|しず}か → {静|しず}からしい, {雨|あめ} → {雨|あめ}らしい) · past: + たらしい ({行|い}った → {行|い}ったらしい)
grammar.explanation: Passes on what you heard or read, with a sense of 'it seems likely'. Softer and vaguer than 〜そうだ, which simply reports. Classic mistake: no だ before it, so {雨|あめ}らしい, never {雨|あめ}だらしい.

examples.jp: {来週|らいしゅう}はもっと{寒く|さむく}なるらしいです。
examples.en: Apparently it's going to get even colder next week.

examples.jp: {駅前|えきまえ}の{新しい|あたらしい}{店|みせ}、ラーメンが{美味しい|おいしい}らしいよ。
examples.en: I hear the new place by the station does good ramen.

quiz.question: {天気予報|てんきよほう}によると、{明日|あした}は{雪|ゆき}＿＿。
quiz.en: According to the forecast, it'll be snow tomorrow.
quiz.explain: Nouns take らしい directly: {雪|ゆき}らしい, with no だ.

quiz_more.question: {店|みせ}の{人|ひと}の{話|はなし}では、{七草|ななくさ}セットは{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に＿＿らしい。
quiz_more.en: According to the shop, the herb sets sold out in the morning.
quiz_more.explain: It already happened: plain past + らしい.

quiz_more.question: {空|そら}が{真っ暗|まっくら|pitch dark|3}だ。{今|いま}にも{雨|あめ}が{降り|ふり}＿＿だ。
quiz_more.en: The sky's pitch dark. It looks like it'll rain any minute.
quiz_more.explain: You see it yourself right now: stem + そうだ. らしい is for what you heard.

kanji.where: A red card stuck on the crates of mandarins and leeks outside {八百勝|やおかつ}.
kanji.breakdown: {本日|ほんじつ} today + {入荷|にゅうか}: 入 come in + 荷 goods → 'goods that came in today'.
kanji.related: {入荷待|にゅうかま}ち = waiting for new stock.

tip.title: Seven herbs on 7 January
tip.body: On 7 January people eat {七草|ななくさ}がゆ, rice porridge with seven spring herbs (せり, なずな, ごぎょう, はこべら, ほとけのざ, すずな, すずしろ), to wish for a healthy year and rest the stomach after New Year feasting. Few people pick them now: supermarkets sell ready-made packs for a few days only.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん on the family LINE: 「{七草|ななくさ}、あった？」 You replied, but one part is wrong.

parts.jp: {午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{売り切れて|うりきれて}いました。
{数|かず}が{少ない|すくない}だらしいです。
parts.why: い-adjectives take らしい directly: {少|すく}ないらしい, no だ.

parts.jp: 3{時|じ}にまた{行きます|いきます}。

challenge.model_answer: {午前中|ごぜんちゅう}に{売り切れて|うりきれて}いました。{寒波|かんぱ|cold wave|2}のせいで、{数|かず|number, quantity|3}が{少ない|すくない}らしいです。3{時|じ}にまた{行きます|いきます}。
challenge.explanation: 〜のせいで blames the cold wave. {少|すく}ないらしい passes on what the notice said without claiming it as your own fact, and です makes it polite for {恵子|けいこ}さん. Nothing goes between an い-adjective and らしい.
challenge.hint: Look at what comes right before らしい

vocab.note: ご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけする = to cause trouble (humble). {迷惑|めいわく}メール = spam.

vocab.jp: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません
vocab.reading: もうしわけありません
vocab.note: Work and customer apologies; much stronger than すみません.
Polite ちょっと: {少々|しょうしょう}お{待|ま}ちください.
{税|ぜい} tax + {込|こ}み included. Opposite: {税抜|ぜいぬ}き.
Shop word, more formal than {売|う}り{切|き}れ.
Written, formal: お{詫|わ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます. Seen on shop and train notices.
Also read いちば (a market you walk around).
{数|かず}が{少|すく}ない = there are few. {数|すう} in compounds: {人数|にんずう}.
{追加|ついか}で = as extra. {追加注文|ついかちゅうもん} = an extra order.

kanji_study.parts: Three 口 boxes stacked up → items piled on a shop shelf: goods.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 器 (container): 器 has four 口 around 大.

kanji_study.parts: 力 strength + 口 mouth → adding your voice to someone's effort: to add, to join in.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 協 (cooperate): 協 has 十 and three 力; 加 is one 力 and 口.

extras.title: Shop keigo on paper
extras.title_jp: お{店|みせ}の{敬語|けいご}
extras.intro: Phrases you'll see on notices and hear at the till.

items.jp: {入荷|にゅうか|new stock arriving|2}いたします
ご{来店|らいてん|coming to the shop|2}いただき
items.note: Always followed by ありがとうございます.

items.jp: ご{了承|りょうしょう|understanding, acceptance|2}ください
items.note: The polite 'sorry, that's how it is'.

extras.title: The seven spring herbs
extras.intro: Kids learn them as a rhythm: せり、なずな、ごぎょう、はこべら、ほとけのざ、すずな、すずしろ.
